Open-R1: a fully open reproduction of DeepSeek-R1

Published: 2026-05-09

Canonical link: https://huggingface.co/blog/open-r1

Author: Elie Bakouch, Leandro von Werra, Lewis Tunstall

Open-R1 is a fully open reproduction of DeepSeek-R1 with a transparent training recipe and reproducible reasoning experiments.

DeepSeek-R1 showed that test-time reasoning can materially improve mathematics, coding, and logic performance.

What is DeepSeek-R1?

Open-R1: the missing pieces

  • Open datasets for reasoning traces.
  • Open training recipes for reinforcement learning.
